card.name: Chew in do-not-crush instructions
card.fires_on: The word "chew" (or its ending "ed") right after "crush", "split" or "not" in tablet and capsule instructions to swallow whole.

modes.label: The warning not to crush or chew
modes.description: The word chew follows crush, cut or split in a warning about handling tablets or capsules.
modes.example: Do not crush or<< chew>> the tablet.

modes.label: The word chewed in an all-caps warning
modes.description: The ending "ed" completes CHEWED in a capitalized warning about capsule contents.
modes.example: THE CONTENTS OF THE Verapamil Hydrochloride Extended-release Capsules (PM) CAPSULE SHOULD NOT BE CRUSHED OR CHEW<<ED>>.

card.writes: It promotes chewing and swallowing words, so the text continues about chewing, biting or swallowing.
card.plain: It responds to the word "chew" in instructions telling patients not to crush or chew a tablet.
